bio: Located along one of the Baixa district’s busy streets, this extremely welcoming restaurant with an open kitchen visible at the entrance is a good dining option, particularly as it has now come of age.Here, chef João Sá, who can often be seen passing from table to table serving and explaining his dishes in detail to guests, offers world cuisine with plenty of personality that combines tradition, the very best Portuguese ingredients and an array of globally influenced flavours, with a particular and intense focus on Asia.
